correctness.rationale: PASS. For n>=5 iid uniform circle spacings, an undirected reciprocal nearest-neighbor pair is exactly a cyclic local minimum of adjacent gaps, whereas a radius-r isolated vertex is an adjacent pair of gaps exceeding r. Conditional on k high gaps, exchangeability makes the rank permutation uniform and E[M|Q=k]=n/3. Conditioning on two specified adjacent high gaps and enumerating local minima in their four neighboring positions proves Cov(M,I|Q=k)=-k(k-1)(n-k)(n-k-1)/[3(n-1)(n-2)(n-3)]. Dirichlet-simplex joint survival P(G_1,...,G_j>r)=(1-jr)_+^(n-1) and inclusion-exclusion give Cov=-n/3[(1-2r)_+^(n-1)-2(1-3r)_+^(n-1)+(1-4r)_+^(n-1)]. Positivity of the relevant open simplex cells gives strict negativity for 0<r<1/2; the boundary cases r=0 and 1/2 give zero, and scaling r_n=(log n+x)/(2n) yields -exp(-x)/3. Independently enumerated all rank permutations at n=5,6,7,8 and every k with exact Fraction arithmetic, matching the displayed conditional covariance. Finite enumerations corroborate but do not prove general n.
residual_risks: Independently repeated finite computations do not substitute for universal arguments, which were separately reconstructed where applicable.

An exact mixed covariance over the complete radius range, its strict negative sign and nonzero rare-isolation critical limit answer a dependence question not implied by either marginal expectation. The universal exchangeable-rank conditional formula is additionally reusable in other circular-spacing laws; this is not a one-off numerical lookup.
